name: Instant Radiosity / Virtual Point Lights (VPLs)
definition: A method for indirect illumination that treats photons as virtual point lights emitting into the scene, using a lighting pass and a rendering pass based on gathering rather than density estimation.
summary: Instant Radiosity treats stored photons as discrete light sources, differing from density estimation by using a visibility-based gathering pass that requires fewer samples but risks singularity artifacts.
